title: Fly in a system: operations
description: The calls through which a host drives the game.

entities.name: Power on
entities.description: A new game on the title, with the start pilot saved and playing.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call. SimHost (src/presentation/bridge) and the tests call it.
entities.result: A FlyInSystem in the title mode; the main generator has discarded the 54 power-on stardust draws.

entities.name: Run one tick
entities.description: Runs one 12 Hz tick, two substeps, with the held actions and the presses since the last tick.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call. SimHost (src/presentation/bridge) and the tests call it.
entities.result: The tick's events in order (Event); the game's state has moved on one tick.
failures: A press the present mode does not accept is dropped, with no event.
While paused only the pause handler's presses act.

entities.name: Load a pilot
entities.description: Loads the pilot named name from a PilotStore; only on the title.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call. SimHost (src/presentation/bridge) and the tests call it.
entities.result: Some(Ok) when the record was accepted and is now the saved and playing pilot.
failures: None when not on the title.
Some(Err(LoadError::NotFound)) when there is no record; Some(Err(…)) when the record is rejected; nothing changes.

entities.name: Save the pilot
entities.description: Saves the playing pilot under name to a PilotStore; only while docked.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call. SimHost (src/presentation/bridge) and the tests call it.
entities.result: SaveOutcome::Saved: the saved pilot is a copy of the playing one and its record was handed to the store.
failures: SaveOutcome::NoName when the name is empty once the name prompt's rules are applied (A–Z and 0–9 kept, letters in capitals, at most 7).

entities.name: Advance the tick clock
entities.description: Adds a frame's time and says how many ticks to run.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call. SimHost (src/presentation/bridge) and the tests call it.
entities.result: The whole ticks due; TickClock::alpha then says how far the frame is towards the next tick.
failures: A frame longer than MAX_FRAME_SECONDS (0.25 s) counts as 0.25 s; a non-finite one as 0.

relatedViews.relationship: The modes a tick moves through.
